psd-to-jpg-converter.formula:
raw_size = width × height × channels   (bytes, uncompressed)
RLE: each channel stores height row-lengths + PackBits-coded rows
pixel(i) = planes RGB(A) or Gray(A) → RGBA for display
howTo: Choose your .psd (or .psb) file with the file picker.
Wait a moment while the tool parses the embedded preview image.
Check the dimensions, color mode, and compression shown in the results.
Set the JPG quality if you plan to download JPG.
Press Download PNG or Download JPG to save the converted image.
keyFacts: A PSD stores a flattened composite preview of the artwork at the end of the file — that is what this tool reads.
Both raw (uncompressed) and RLE-compressed previews are supported.
8-bit RGB and grayscale files are supported, including files with an alpha channel.
The .psb (large document) format shares the same header structure and is also accepted.
Parsing happens entirely in your browser with no libraries or uploads.

psd-to-jpg-converter.workedExample:
A 1920 × 1080 px, 3-channel RGB PSD stored uncompressed:
raw bytes = 1920 × 1080 × 3 = 6,220,800 bytes (≈ 5.9 MB)
The tool skips the header, color data, resources, and layer sections, then reads those 6,220,800 bytes as three planes (red, green, blue) and rebuilds the full-color image pixel by pixel.
